question.text: For the purpose of computing Series NAV in a Cat III AIF, allocation of fund expenses (other than management fees) across different series is generally done:

answer.text: Equally among all series irrespective of size
In proportion to the Opening Series NAV of each series

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per the chapter: 'Fund Expenses... that are not specifically attributable to a specific series of units shall generally be allocated amongst all the series and class of units, in proportion to the Opening Series NAV of each series issued by the Fund.' **The Trap:** Equal allocation ignores size. Newest-only/Class-D-only are cherry-picking that regulators prohibit. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-B and XIX-C test series-NAV mechanics. Cross-ref: Cat I/II uses drawdown waterfalls (XIX-D). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Programme the fund-admin system so fund-level expenses auto-allocate by opening series NAV at each valuation day - manual allocation is the #1 source of NAV restatements.
